name: web-architectures
description: A full-stack habit tracking application built with React + Vite (frontend) and Express (backend).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run e2e:ci
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage:frontend
scripts.ports:clean: kill-port 3100 5174 || echo Test ports were already free
scripts.start:backend:test: cross-env PORT=3100 FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:5174 npm --prefix backend run start:test
scripts.e2e:ci: npm run ports:clean && start-server-and-test "npm run start:backend:test" http://localhost:3100/api/health "start-server-and-test \"npm run start:frontend:test\" http://localhost:5174 \"npm run e2e:run:ci\""
